metrics.label: YouTube views
metrics.definition: YouTube's view count for the selected report and dimensions; it is not treated as equivalent to another platform's view or play metric.

metrics.label: YouTube engaged views
metrics.definition: Views that continued past the first frame or began through an explicit play interaction under the YouTube Analytics definition.

metrics.label: YouTube estimated watch time
metrics.definition: Estimated total minutes watched for the selected YouTube report scope.

metrics.label: YouTube average view duration
metrics.definition: Average playback duration in seconds under YouTube's report definition; looping-clips traffic exclusions follow the provider definition.

metrics.label: YouTube likes
metrics.definition: Likes recorded by YouTube for the selected report scope.

metrics.label: YouTube comments
metrics.definition: Comments recorded by YouTube for the selected report scope.

metrics.label: YouTube shares
metrics.definition: Shares recorded by YouTube for the selected report scope.

metrics.label: YouTube engagement rate by views
metrics.definition: Versioned ratio of YouTube likes, comments, and shares to YouTube views. It is unavailable when any input is missing or the denominator is zero.
metrics.source_api_version: FLOW derived from YouTube Analytics core metrics

metrics.label: Instagram total views
metrics.definition: Instagram video view count across supported surfaces under the selected API contract, including replays and promoted views where the provider definition includes them.

metrics.label: Instagram total likes
metrics.definition: Instagram's total likes for the owned top-level media object, including associated promoted surfaces where documented.

metrics.label: Instagram total comments
metrics.definition: Instagram's total comments for the owned top-level media object across supported surfaces.

metrics.label: Instagram shares
metrics.definition: Number of times the owned Instagram media was shared when the field is available to the authorized account.

metrics.label: Instagram saves
metrics.definition: Number of times the owned Instagram media was saved when the field is available to the authorized account.

metrics.label: Instagram engagement rate by views
metrics.definition: Versioned ratio of Instagram likes, comments, shares, and saves to Instagram total views. It is unavailable when any input is missing or the denominator is zero.
metrics.source_api_version: FLOW derived from owned Instagram media fields

metrics.label: Facebook Reel initial plays
metrics.definition: Reel sessions with at least one millisecond of playback after an impression, excluding replays under Meta's metric definition.
metrics.source_api_version: Meta Video Insights lifetime Reel metric

metrics.label: Facebook Reel total plays
metrics.definition: Reel sessions with at least one millisecond of playback after an impression, including replays under Meta's metric definition.
metrics.source_api_version: Meta Video Insights lifetime Reel metric

metrics.label: Facebook Reel unique impressions
metrics.definition: Estimated number of people who saw the Reel at least once, whether or not they played it.
metrics.source_api_version: Meta Video Insights lifetime Reel metric

metrics.label: Facebook Reel average watch time
metrics.definition: Average milliseconds played per play instance, including replay time; the value can exceed the Reel duration.
metrics.source_api_version: Meta Video Insights lifetime Reel metric

metrics.label: Facebook Reel total watch time
metrics.definition: Total milliseconds the Reel played, including replay time.
metrics.source_api_version: Meta Video Insights lifetime Reel metric

metrics.label: Facebook Reel follows
metrics.definition: Follows attributed to the Reel under Meta's lifetime Reel metric definition.
metrics.source_api_version: Meta Video Insights lifetime Reel metric

metrics.label: Facebook Reel reactions by type
metrics.definition: Structured reaction counts by reaction type; this is not flattened into a scalar like count.
metrics.source_api_version: Meta Video Insights lifetime Reel metric

metrics.label: Facebook Reel social actions
metrics.definition: Structured comments and shares returned under Meta's Reel social-actions metric; components remain provider-defined.
metrics.source_api_version: Meta Video Insights lifetime Reel metric
